description: Display-name helpers for diagram templates and their categories: resolves the localized text through resource keys derived from the template Id (TmDiagramTemplate_<id>) and the category name (TmDiagramTemplateCategory_<category>), falling back to the raw authored values, so the DiagramTemplate model itself stays unchanged.

members.name: GetTemplateName
members.description: Returns the localized display name for a template: the translation of the key derived from its Id when the key resolves, otherwise the template's raw name.

members.name: GetCategoryName
members.description: Returns the localized category label: the translation of the key derived from the category when the key resolves, otherwise the raw category name.

members.name: GetLocalizedText
members.description: Resolves a localized text for a resource key, falling back to the provided value when the key is empty or untranslated (localizers echoing [key] are treated as missing).
